purpose: Teach: 琉球/盛岡/大宮/八王子/ケンブリッジ/シベリア/サンパウロ/平壌

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが琉球の三線を弾いて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father is going to play the Okinawan three-string for us.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact sharing of good news. Gentle lift on his name. Soft pace, inviting him to feel pleased without pressure. Voice settling at the end like a small gift being given.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと盛岡冷麺また食べたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to eat Morioka cold noodles with Dad again.
lines.style: Bright, direct request with genuine longing underneath. Quick attack on the desire. Small, earnest voice—not whining, just sincere wanting. Slight eager rise at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが大宮で打ち合わせされるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father has a meeting in Omiya, it seems.
lines.style: Gentle announcement of a logistical reality. Quiet, accepting tone. Slight pause before the location—acknowledging what this might mean. No drama, just the quiet way mothers hold small disappointments.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと八王子の親戚行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I went to see relatives in Hachioji with Dad.
lines.style: Proud, matter-of-fact report of something that happened. Quick, clear delivery. Small voice full of its own importance—he's sharing a memory he's held onto. Slight warmth on 'with Dad.'

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがケンブリッジ大学への留学経験を話して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father shared his experience studying at Cambridge.
lines.style: Reflective, admiring tone. Slow, deliberate pace—she's appreciating what he shared. Soft wonder in her voice, like she's still turning the story over. Quiet trailing-off, as if the moment lingers.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとシベリア鉄道のドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched a documentary about the Trans-Siberian Railway with Dad.
lines.style: Eager, present-tense excitement despite past tense verb. Quick rhythm, stacking details like they're all equally thrilling. Breathless delivery—he wants her to see how big and interesting it was. Voice bright with the weight of shared attention.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがサンパウロのカーニバルのお話して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father told us about Carnival in São Paulo.
lines.style: Admiring, gentle reflection. Slower pace, savoring the exotic detail. Warmth in her voice—she's pleased by what he brings home to share. Soft, almost dreamy delivery, like she's still picturing it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと平壌のニュース見たよ、難しかったよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched the news about Pyongyang with Dad, and it was hard to understand.
lines.style: Quiet, thoughtful delivery. Slight hesitation after mentioning the news—weighing what he saw. Earnest admission of confusion without self-criticism. Soft voice, reaching slightly for reassurance. Small, genuine reflection at the end.
